bibliographic.title: 多模态医养大数据动态聚合与智慧服务模式
bibliographic.authors: 杨雪洁; 刘佳; 吴青筱; 王雨菲; 顾东晓
bibliographic.citation_apa: Yang, X., Liu, J., Wu, Q., Wang, Y., & Gu, D. (2025). Dynamic aggregation of multimodal healthcare and eldercare big data and intelligent service model. Journal of Agricultural Library and Information Science, 37(4), 24-38. https://doi.org/10.13998/j.cnki.issn1002-1248.25-0079

methodology.method_family: literature review and conceptual framework development
methodology.study_design: framework proposal with literature synthesis and methodological component design
methodology.technology_context: multimodal healthcare and eldercare big data integration, knowledge graphs, NLP, machine learning, deep learning, explainable machine learning, human-machine collaboration

eligibility.exclusion_reason: The article addresses multimodal healthcare/eldercare big data aggregation, knowledge discovery, and intelligent service frameworks, not conversational AI, LLM-based systems, or conversational governance.
eligibility.decision_rationale: Although the paper operates in regulated healthcare, mentions NLP/machine learning, human-machine collaboration, privacy, compliance, and risk-related governance in references, its central object is cross-organizational multimodal health data fusion and proactive knowledge services. The provided text contains no primary treatment of conversational systems, chatbots, agents, RAG, guardrails, observability, human oversight in dialogue, or governance of generative LLM interactions.
eligibility.manual_spotcheck_reason: Full text clearly centers on healthcare big data aggregation and knowledge service architecture rather than conversational LLM governance.

appraisal.notes: Conceptual/methodological framework paper with literature synthesis; no empirical participant sample or conversational-system evaluation is described in the provided text.

cerqual.explanation: Internal coherence is moderate for a healthcare big-data framework, but relevance to conversational governance in LLM systems is very low because the article does not study conversational interfaces, LLM deployment, or governance mechanisms for generative dialogue.

coding.theme: Multimodal healthcare and eldercare big data aggregation with intelligent knowledge services
coding.subtheme: Cross-domain health data fusion and proactive service modeling
concepts: risk and privacy in health data sharing

synthesis.main_claim: The authors propose a multimodal healthcare and eldercare big data dynamic aggregation framework and an intelligent, demand-driven full-cycle service model to overcome data silos and passive service modes in regulated health environments.
synthesis.contribution: Integrates cross-organizational heterogeneous health data, proposes NLP/ML-based knowledge discovery methods, and outlines a proactive smart health service architecture for healthcare and eldercare.
synthesis.limitations: Provided text emphasizes framework and method design without reporting empirical validation of conversational systems; governance discussion is peripheral and not focused on LLM conversational accountability.
synthesis.use_in_review: Exclude from central evidence on conversational governance in LLM systems; at most a distant contextual citation for regulated healthcare knowledge services, NLP, privacy, and broad risk-governance themes.
